title: knowledge context and dispatch prepare resolve granted-worktree roots natively
action: Debt row 621 core: build_context_manifest (knowledge/context.rs, ManifestOut::NeedsNode at ~194-311) and its verbatim port copy in drivers/kctx.rs (~704-818) return NeedsNode on linked/granted-worktree roots — with no Node behind the signal, `bee knowledge context` from a granted worktree silently returns nothing (routing.rs:335 -> None) and `bee dispatch prepare` drops its learned-context block (prepare.rs:291 -> Delegate). Fix: resolve worktree topology natively in both — the grant-aware resolution already exists natively (status_full.rs find_granted_worktree_for_feature and the crate's roots module; follow how native verbs that work from a worktree resolve main root vs island store) — so both sites produce the same manifest a main-checkout call produces (bundle lives in the repo tree, shared across worktrees; anchor resolution per B9 unchanged). NeedsNode variants disappear from both files (delete the dead arms and their conversions at routing.rs:335 / prepare.rs:291 if now unreachable). Behavior from the MAIN checkout stays byte-identical. TDD red-first: fixture repo + git worktree add + grant-shaped root proving knowledge context returns a manifest from the worktree root (red: today None/NeedsNode); dispatch prepare's learned-context block renders from a worktree fixture; main-checkout tests pinned unchanged.

truths: bee knowledge context returns a real manifest when invoked from a granted worktree root
dispatch prepare's learned-context block renders from a worktree
main-checkout output byte-identical; no NeedsNode variant remains in either file

artifacts.substantive: native worktree-roots resolution plus tests, no TODO stubs

trace.outcome: real bug fixed: dispatch prepare's learned-context bundle now reads from the cell's granted worktree (control-root fallback when none); named deviation: knowledge context from a worktree already resolves via the wide door (proven empirically), NeedsNode kept as legitimate non-worktree refusal paths
